businesses.business: municipal and industrial specialty vehicles and safety equipment

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures street sweepers, sewer cleaners, hydro-excavation trucks, vacuum trucks, dump truck bodies, and safety and signaling equipment. Sells mainly to municipalities, contractors and industrial customers through dealers and direct sales, and supplies aftermarket parts and service.

primary_products.value: street sweepers; sewer cleaning and hydro-excavation trucks; industrial vacuum loaders; dump truck bodies and trailers; warning lights, sirens and public safety equipment

primary_services.value: aftermarket parts and repair service; equipment rental; used equipment sales

customer_segment.value: B2G: municipalities, airports, police, fire and emergency agencies; B2B: contractors, industrial operators, utilities, rental firms

end_markets.value: municipal infrastructure; construction; industrial cleaning; public safety; utilities

revenue_model.value: product sales: specialty vehicles, bodies and safety equipment; service fees: aftermarket parts, repair and maintenance; rental or leasing: equipment rentals
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds vehicles and equipment from chassis and purchased components, sold to governments and contractors; service provider: parts, repair and rental support for installed equipment

geography_served.value: global: United States and Canada primarily, plus Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: environmental solutions vehicles, safety and security systems, and specialty vehicles sharing municipal customers

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent dealer network for sweepers, trucks and safety products; direct sales: sales to large municipal and industrial accounts; own locations: company-owned service and rental centers
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: vehicle emissions and safety standards (EPA, CARB, DOT), plus public procurement rules
